# 1ai-payment — LLM Context Index

> Machine-readable index for LLM context injection. Payment gateway aggregation microservice for 1ai-ecosystem.

## Core
Unified API for creating payments across 13 gateways
- docs/00-overview.md: System overview, problem statement, design principles, scope
- docs/01-architecture.md: Architecture diagrams, data flow, database schema, deployment
- docs/02-api-reference.md: API contracts, request/response schemas, authentication
- docs/03-gateway-specs.md: Per-gateway integration specs (Midtrans, Tripay, Duitku, NOWPayments, iPaymu, Scalev, Xendit, Telegram Stars, Telegram Payments, PayPal)
- docs/04-rollout-plan.md: Migration phases, rollback plan, monitoring, security checklist
- docs/05-product-roadmap.md: Product roadmap (gateways, features, phases)

- src/index.ts: Entry point — Bun.serve, DB init, nexus cron startup, graceful shutdown (SIGTERM/SIGINT)
- src/app.ts: OpenAPIHono app factory — CORS, rate limits, mounts /api + /webhook + /health + /metrics, OpenAPI JSON at GET /doc, Swagger UI at GET /reference, static / (landing) + /dashboard
Supports 13 gateways + Nexus (Scalev variant → tier)
- src/config/database.ts: LibSQL/SQLite initialization, schema creation, default merchant seed, migrations
- src/config/migrations.ts: Versioned migration runner (append-only, tracked in _migrations table)

- src/gateways/base.ts: PaymentGateway interface with createPayment, verifySignature, normalizeEvent, getPaymentMethods, refundPayment (Provider/Plugin pattern)
- src/gateways/midtrans.ts: Midtrans — SHA-512 signature, createPayment via /v2/charge
- src/gateways/tripay.ts: Tripay — HMAC-SHA256 signature, createPayment via /transaction/create
- src/gateways/duitku.ts: Duitku — MD5 signature, createPayment via /webapi/api/merchant/v2/inquiry
- src/gateways/nowpayments.ts: NOWPayments — HMAC-SHA512 signature, createPayment via /v1/invoice
- src/gateways/ipaymu.ts: iPaymu — SHA-256 signature, createPayment via /api/v2/payment
- src/gateways/scalev.ts: Scalev — HMAC-SHA256 signature, createPayment via /v3/stores/{store_id}/public/checkout (checkout.scalev.com redirect)
- src/gateways/xendit.ts: Xendit — X-Callback-Token header, createPayment via /v2/invoices & /callback_virtual_accounts
- src/gateways/telegram-stars/: Telegram Stars (XTR) — Telegram Bot API
- src/gateways/telegram-payments/: Telegram Payments (multi-currency) — Telegram Bot API
- src/gateways/paypal/: PayPal — webhook signature verification API, createPayment via orders API
- src/gateways/x402/: x402 — on-chain USDC micropayments (HTTP 402), payment requirements + RPC tx verification
- src/gateways/erc8183/: ERC-8183 — agentic commerce escrow, attestation-based fund release
across 13 gateways

- src/routes/webhook.ts: POST /webhook/:gateway — verify → normalize → order lookup → dedupe (UNIQUE) → update status → async forward; returns 200 immediately
- src/routes/payment.ts: POST /api/payments (idempotency key), GET /api/payments/:id, GET /api/gateways, GET /api/gateways/:gateway/methods, GET /api/transactions, GET /api/webhook-deliveries — OpenAPIHono + createRoute
- src/routes/refund.ts: POST /api/refunds (partial/full), GET /api/refunds — OpenAPIHono + createRoute
- src/routes/merchant.ts: POST /api/merchants, GET /api/merchants, GET/PATCH /api/merchants/:id, POST /api/merchants/:id/api-key (rotate), GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /api/merchants/:id/gateways — encrypted credential storage
- src/routes/admin.ts: GET /api/admin/merchants — X-Admin-Key protected (timing-safe compare)
- src/routes/register.ts: POST /api/register — public merchant self-signup, 5/hr per-IP limit, API key shown once
- src/routes/health.ts: GET /health — service health + gateway config status

- src/middleware/auth.ts: X-API-Key authentication for /api/* — sha256 lookup in merchants table, sets merchantId/name/plan, env API_KEY fallback
- src/middleware/admin-auth.ts: X-Admin-Key check (timing-safe) for admin endpoints
- src/middleware/rate-limit.ts: In-memory rate limiter — /api/* 60/min, /webhook/* 120/min, /api/register 5/hr; plan tiers (free 30 / pro 120 / enterprise 600 per min) keyed by merchant, 429 + Retry-After
- src/middleware/metrics.ts: prom-client counters + payment duration histogram, exposed at GET /metrics (no auth)

- src/services/order.service.ts: Order registry CRUD, idempotent creates, merchant-scoped lookups, status transitions
- src/services/forwarder.service.ts: Async event forwarding to callback_url — HMAC signature header, 3 retries with backoff, dead-letter on final failure
- src/services/gateway.service.ts: Gateway health status, available gateways, methods listing
- src/services/refund.service.ts: Refund creation (partial/full), gateway refund call or manual pending, order → refunded on full refund
- src/services/nexus-config.service.ts: Scalev variant → tier/duration mapping (NEXUS_VARIANT_MAP env JSON)
- src/services/nexus-fulfillment.service.ts: Scalev payment → customer/subscription upsert → Telegram channel invite (24h, 1 use)
- src/services/nexus-cron.service.ts: 6h cron — expire past-due subscriptions, 48h expiry reminders

- src/utils/crypto.ts: Timing-safe compare, HMAC signing, SHA-256 hash, AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt, ID/key generation
- src/utils/errors.ts: Typed error classes (PaymentError, Signature, OrderNotFound, Duplicate, Gateway, Forward)
- src/utils/logger.ts: Structured logging (no raw payloads — security rule)

- packages/sdk/: @1ai/payment TypeScript SDK — OneAIPayment client (create, get, listTransactions, refund, listRefunds, listGateways)
- src/dashboard/index.html: Merchant portal SPA (self-contained, API-key driven)
- src/landing/index.html: Public landing page (Indonesian, Tailwind CDN)

## Conventions
- Stack: TypeScript / Hono + @hono/zod-openapi / LibSQL (SQLite)
- OpenAPI spec auto-generated from Zod schemas (src/schemas.ts) — no manual YAML
- Provider/Plugin pattern for all gateway integrations
- Idempotent webhooks (duplicate callbacks = same result)
- Thin routing layer (no business logic — credits, subscriptions in owning projects)
- Security-first (signature verification, timing-safe comparison, no payload logging)
- Metadata preserved through full lifecycle (create → callback → forward)
- Metrics: prom-client at GET /metrics (no auth)
- Per-merchant gateway credentials encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) in merchant_gateways
- Nexus: Scalev direct checkout → Telegram channel invite fulfillment for 1ai-product delivery
